newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Gas link bursts in Czech Rep but supplies resumed.
newsitem.headline: Gas link bursts in Czech Rep but supplies resumed.

text.p: A pipeline transporting natural gas from Russia to Germany burst in the eastern Czech Republic early Tuesday morning, link operator Transgas a.s. said.
The company's Deputy Director Zdenek Hain told Reuters that no one was injured in the accident, which ocurred close to the town of Kutna Hora, 80 km east of Prague.
The cause of the accident was unknown, he said.
Hain added that Transgas has already begun transporting the gas through its other pipelines.
"There are more pipelines, so the total drop in the supplies (to Germany) is 10 percent right now... and we hope that in 24 hours the shipments should be back to full," he said.
Hain said that the ruptured pipeline would be fixed in several days.
